meta.source: Ministry of Education, Analysis of Budgeted Expenditure on Education, editions 2007-10 to 2019-22, retrieved from the Wayback Machine (the ministry's own URLs 404).
meta.national_note: Released on28-02-2023 by National Accounts Division, CSO, MOSPI . 16
meta.national_rule: The only Centre-plus-states figure in this repository. Each rupee is counted once, by the government that spends it; never add data/union.json to data/states.json instead.
meta.states_definition: Revenue account expenditure of the education departments only, by sub-sector. Capital, loans and other departments' education spending are not split by sub-sector in the ABE.
meta.state_rows: Codes follow data/reference/states.json; UTs without a legislature use ISO 3166-2:IN. total_states, total_uts and total are the ABE's own printed totals.
